$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-tabs-list) and how to read it.

root.$why: A horizontal list is the sum of its four hugging labels, which rasterise slightly narrower than in Figma (the size check covers it). Figma's root wraps a triggers frame; in code the list lays its triggers out itself.

triggers.$why: The triggers frame is the list itself in code (no gap between the triggers either way).

Tabs Trigger.$why: Triggers hug their label (width follows glyph rasterisation; vertical ones fill the list).
